scope: training feature timestamps and execution horizons

findings.description: Equal averaging of per-interval squared log return divided by elapsed time makes the incomplete final interval disproportionately influential. A single observed1bps change1ms after the retained10s endpoint gives approximately100bps volatility; with no subsequent price change the same input becomes1bps by10s.
findings.implication: Sampling phase can move an otherwise unchanged market context through feature space. Version any formula correction and rebuild or segregate stored feature vectors.
findings.limitation: The feature is explicitly documented as a variance-rate proxy. This reproduction establishes instability, not that it caused all observed missed entries.

findings.description: Fixed raw feature scales and equal-coordinate Euclidean distance cause top1/top5 imbalance and aggressor flow to dominate directional returns. Microprice-minus-mid divided by halfspread is algebraically top1 quantity imbalance.
findings.basis: Efficient bank frozen2026-09-08T08:00:00Z plus16 later prespecified probes per asset; long-5m bank138BTC130ETH; all query-bank pairs, contribution=sum squared coordinate differences divided by sum total squared distances.
findings.implication: Use train-only learned directional partitions or scales in a separately versioned candidate and compare against baselines. More training dates alone do not correct the distance geometry.
findings.limitation: This diagnoses representation weighting; it does not establish predictive direction or profitability.
